subject: Post-discovery: mutual action plan & scheduling the evaluation sessions
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Zhang <emily@heartlandhealth.ai>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@procureco.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 05 May 2026 16:12:00 -0000
Subject: Post-discovery: mutual action plan & scheduling the evaluation sessions

Hi Emily and Tom — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we can lock the evaluation cadence: 

Recap (very high level)
- Primary goal: validate extraction accuracy and latency for triage workflows across typical patient intake PDFs and EHR snippets.
- Key constraints: data residency (US), redaction of PHI during eval, and a 2-week timeline to demonstrate baseline uplift.
- Success metrics you called out: >92% entity extraction F1 on the sample set, end-to-end 95th percentile latency <450ms for 512-token requests, and reproducible prompts for clinical QA.

Proposed immediate next steps
1) Mutual Action Plan (attached): scope, roles, tentative schedule, and required artifacts from Heartland. Please review the MAP and note any changes.
2) Book two sessions: a) Technical deep-dive (engineers + infra) to walk the sample data and integration approach; b) Evaluation kickoff (trial plan, prompt pack, and acceptance criteria). Estimated total time: 90–120 minutes across both.
3) Share sample prompt pack & redaction checklist before kickoff (we can take care of anonymization if you prefer).

Availability (we're on PT):
- Wed 5/6: 10:00–12:00 or 15:00–17:00 PT
- Thu 5/7: 09:00–11:00 PT
- Fri 5/8: 13:00–16:00 PT

If those don't work I can send a Calendly link — or Ben can coordinate directly.

Attached: Heartland_MAP_v1.pdf (mutual action plan) and eval-scope.xlsx (sample prompt list + metadata requirements).

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

— Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0132

Thanks Vanessa — great summary. Tom and I reviewed and the MAP looks sensible. A couple quick clarifications before we finalize: 

- Can you confirm if Redwood will host the trial (hosted API) or if we need a dedicated VPC/Private eval? For procurement we need to know data flow assumptions.
- For the prompt pack, we can surface a 150-record gold set by EOD Monday; would that work?

As for scheduling — Thu 5/7 09:30–10:30 PT works well for a technical deep-dive with our engineers. For the evaluation kickoff, could we do Fri 5/8 14:00–15:00 PT? If not, early next week is also fine.

Attendees: Emily Zhang (PO), Tom Reynolds (Procurement lead), Sarah Lee (Lead ML Engineer) — Sarah should join the technical deep-dive.

Thanks,
Emily

emily@heartlandhealth.ai

Emily — thanks for the fast reply and the proposed slots. Vanessa asked me to coordinate calendars and confirm logistics. Summary and a few operational notes: 

1) Hosting model: For the trial we can run hosted with RBAC and encrypted-at-rest (Redwood hosted API) — that path keeps setup fastest. If you need a VPC/deployment plan we can prepare an options doc and timeline; that would add 2–3 weeks for networking and security review.

2) Data handling: We will accept the 150-record gold set. Please include a plain-text manifest (csv) with record IDs and a brief description of redaction expectations. Redwood will not retain raw inputs beyond the eval retention window (14 days) unless you ask otherwise — detailed terms in the MAP.

3) Technical deep-dive (Thu 5/7 09:30–10:30 PT):
- Agenda: share sample payloads, proposed integration (API vs S3), performance profile we expect to measure, and any auth/PEM questions.
- Attendees from Redwood: Ben Carter (Solutions Engineer), Vanessa Ortiz (AE)
- Request: Sarah Lee to share a small example PDF and one EHR snippet in advance (anonymized).

4) Evaluation kickoff (Fri 5/8 14:00–15:00 PT):
- Agenda: finalize the trial plan, agree acceptance criteria and measurement plan, hand off prompt pack.

I've attached Heartland_MAP_v1.pdf (with a couple inline comments) and eval-scope.xlsx (column headers + sample rows). Also included a one-click scheduling link if you'd rather pick times: https://calendar.redwood.ai/s/vanessa/15min

If those slots work, I'll create the invites and include dial-in details + a short runbook for the trial.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
